notes:
v9-claude: Claude's recommended version of v8.
Both threads use the same loop: Agent → Context check → ① Safe point → ② Compact or hand over → back.
Colours mean the same thing everywhere: blue task · green result · violet start fresh worker · orange getting full · cyan safe point reached · red compacted → continue · pink hand over / takes over · yellow handover check.
Boxes stay short; detail is in each box's Details panel (rules, descriptions, link notes).
progress.md is the single source of truth (OWNER line, checkpoints, log). Noisy work (tests, logs, big reviews) goes to subagents.
Exit check (a Quality gate, self-checked for now): a worker sends a result only after its exit check passes (tests, tagged commit, checkpoint, how-to-verify). Catching mistakes there is cheaper than review round trips, which fill the orchestrator's context. Fix rounds per task: max 2, then tell the user. To really enforce it, add a Codex Stop hook and set the gate's "Enforced by" to Hook.
Handoff check (a Quality gate, self-checked): before a worker sends a handoff doc, all 5 sections are filled in, failing tests are listed under Open issues, the doc is committed [M01_H00] and git status is clean. A handover skips the Exit check (partly done work).
Names: 00 - Orchestrator O## · workers M##_H## - milestone name.
